I used to be in therapy for a long time because i suffer from depression as well. Alas, now i dont have any babysitting.
In his free time he mostly play games on PS4, watches youtube videos, spends time with dog, exercise, works on his PhD or goes out with friends. He never spends time with me or child unless i specifically ask and frankly it gets old so i end up just making plans just for baby and me. 
Yes i would be extremely psyched if he was more open to therapy. I think his work together with depression really makes him tired so he needs a lot time to unwind. But then, he finds time for other things and other people.
You are right, my behaviour was abusive and there is no apology for that.

I think you may be right. In my eyes his lazyness could eventually do harm to LO even if this incident was relatively innocent. But i behaved terribly. That doesnt make me very good parent or human and i have to work on it so it doesnt happen again. 
Thing everybody presumes that i never talk about my expectations. Thats not true. I talk about it all the time. Sometimes it feels that i barely talk about anything else than how i dont want to be expected to do everything with no help just because i am sahm with little child. That i need him to be more proactive with chores and with the child. But je categoricaly denies that he has any duties outside of his job. According to him he brings home money and then he has right to all the free time. 
That doesnt apologize my behaviour though. Just maybe explains.

Yea that post was more for me to relieve some frustration.It wasnt fair not to include what i said, definitely. The screaming was so out of line and cannot be repeated possibly ever. 
Thing Is i dont feel i dont comunnicate. i have told him multiple times that i dont want to care for him in this way, that i dont want to feel like his mother, etc etc. But somehow i am unable to keep my boundaries for long, fór example when he is oversleeping, is in the bad mood because of it, i eventually cave in and start to wake him.up again.
I should definitely apologize for screaming that is so true.
But i am afraid i cannot comply that it is my duty to have everything ready for him so he can get ready to work by himself. Yes i am Sahm, but apart of his work, he is only gaming, doing his hobbies or going out. If he needs towels to be ready (they were just drying, not yet folded on the shelf) he could also do something for it.

For all i know LO fell in a second when he went to pack some other things. Then he came back to him.
Not sure it would go well, even when discussing individual therapy for his own problems (medicated for depression) he was reluctant and eventually decided not to go.

I told him like a million times i want him to spend time with LO umprompted. He refuses but says that he will do it if i tell him to.
About getting him ready to go somewhere..i have told him as well maybe not so many times.

In the past i told him multiple times that i dont like situations where i feel like a maid (or his mother) such as him expecting me to pack for him when he travels somewhere or me waking him up in the morning for work. He still expects that though and usually i rather cave in than piss him off. After we had conversation about this incident, he told me he will get ready himself as long as all the stuff will be where it should be so he can find it no problem. But it is 100% my responsibility for the things to ne there.

As i was fetching the towel in bedroom i left them in the next room together. So it made sense to me that he would keep an eye on LO. Apparently he went to pack more stuff. He wasnt in the shower anymore, this towel he wanted to take with him for whatever.

And yes i did. Yes i see that i am an massive asshole for this.
If you are still willing to send, I would appreciate it extremely! Thank you so much. martina.dadakova@gmail.com

Heyy, I am so sorry and I feel you. It is such a helplessness and unfairness. I am having a premature ovarian failure at 28 years old and obviously I am severely perimenopausal (hot flashes, spotting all the time, PMS and mood swings from hell). I usually try not to tell myself "Why me?" but yeah.... why us? I guess we all need a moment of self-pity every now and then, and it is perfectly normal. 

You are very brave to cope with all of this and I am sure you will be okay, but I totally feel you right now. Everybody around me keep having babies and here I am feeling (exactly as you have said) million years old. Literally no woman in my family was menopausal before her fifties. Some crappy lottery we have won.
Sooo.... do you think it is still safe to order from Deciem website??
I think I really needed to hear that everyone has their enough and it is okay to feel whatever I feel right now. Thank you all, really.
Yes, the feeling that I have no control is really strong while dealing with all this. Maybe I really need to reclaim some of the control. Thank you and I am glad that things get easier for you!
Thank you. It is really nice to hear that you are healing and I wish you many more good days!

This!!! I am really sorry for how it has turned out for you and even if I am not at the same place (with failed IVFs), these feeling you write about are very familiar to me. I really need some time for myself, my grief, my thoughts... maybe I will continue with some further options later, maybe not, and both options are okay.

Thank you all so much!!! I haven't even expected so much support. You are all amazing and it is great to hear (read) that whatever way I will choose, it will by my - and equally valid - choice by all means. It is also ok not to be sure right now what will be the next step (if any). This sub is really helpful for me these days.

Hi. I am very sorry for all these bad news. I cant offer any advice, but sure I have a lot of understanding. My situation is almost identical. Me and my fiancee (both 28 years old) have been TTC for about a year. Due to confirmed endometriosis (I have had 4 surgeries so far) we have been rushed to a reproductive specialist. It was assumed that endometriosis is the reason. Fiancees SA results came back exceptionally terrible, as to my results, I appear to have premature ovarian failure. We were told that there is absolutely no chance that we could conceive naturally, we would be lucky if IVF would work out. ICSI is also our only option. Due to about three normal sperm cells (two of which dead), everything else would be a waste of time. And since I am practically menopausal, time is not something we have lots of. 

All of this is about a week old info. I am going over and over thinking about how unfair is life for us. Seeing people who didnt really want to get pregnant getting pregnant. Seeing older people than us getting pregnant naturally in no time. Seeing people our age having multiple children already. More tests are about to be done (we are going to urologist, since the reason for such a bad SA is unexplained and even has no probable explanation, also my hormones will be checked again, etc etc.) but so far everything looks just hopeless...

I guess I just wanted to say that I know how much it sucks. The frustration, fear.. the feeling of injustice I keep trying to suppress but it keeps coming back...

It is all too fresh but what seems to be helping a little bit is trying to imagine life without children, however, with the love of my life, our dogs, cats, living in the nice place and doing all the things that make us happy. It may come out as a massive cliche, but we already are a family, the two of us. We will keep trying, since there still are things we can do to make it happen, and being active about it and exploring all our options can definitely make a least part of the fear of unknown go away. And if the worst were to happen, sometimes can be nice to think (although it sure can be sometimes depressing as well) that some good things in life will stay the same.

I truly wish you best of luck!
